# <span id="aanchor359"></span> Unrolled Meters

## Tab Details

#### Unrolled Meters Tab

As data is imported or edited within FLOWCAL, the data is queued to roll. The [rollup service](All%20Services.md#MeterRollup) calculates hourly, daily, and monthly data for meters and locations from the periodic values. The resulting data is used for reporting and can be viewed within one of the [rollup viewers](../../Rollup%20Viewers/Meter-Location%20Rollups/Meter-Location%20Rollups.md) or by running a report or export.

The Unrolled Meters tab displays data for meters that have not rolled or were not rolled successfully. Data that did not roll successfully will display with a status of "Postponed".

To remove warnings about data failing to roll when running reports, select the desired meters and click the **Ignore** button. The data will refresh and the meters will have a status of "Ignored" and will not be re-rolled. If the problem that caused rollup failure has been corrected, select the desired meters and click the **Queue** button. The data will refresh and the selected meters will have a status of "In Queue". You can then try the rollup again.

#### Columns

- **Meter Number** - Displays the meter number.
- **Meter Name** - Displays the meter name.
- **Start Date** - The first date for which data will be rolled for the meter.
- **End Date** - The last date for which data will be rolled for the meter.
- **Status**
  - **Ignored** - Data for the meter was queued for rolling but failed. The data was then set to be ignored.It will not be re-rolled until it has a status of "In Queue".
  - **In Queue** - Data for the meter has been placed in the queue, but the rollups service has not rolled it yet. Clicking **Queue** or clicking the **Ignore** button on "In Queue" data will have no effect.
  - **Postponed** - The rollups service tried to roll data for this meter, but an error occurred. More information about the reason for the failure can be found in the log files.
- **GMS Date** - The date on which the data was queued to be rolled.

#### Buttons

- **Hold** - Put records in the queue on hold. The records will not be processed until the status is changed back to "In Queue".
- **Ignore** - Ignore meters that were postponed.
- **Queue** - Change the status of a record to "In Queue". Rollups will try to re-roll the data.
- **Refresh** - Refresh the display to check the status of rollups (display does not refresh automatically).
- **Exit** - Close the screen.
